messages:
Lara Chen: Quick sync — we need a concise set of Launch Gates for the Console observability work (dashboards, tracing, error analysis, retention). Goal: draft OKR checklist today. Who can jump in for 30m?
Ben Ortiz: I can. Quick thought: split Beta vs GA gates. Beta = internal + 2–3 pilot customers. GA = SLA + perf + export/compliance features.
Maria Gomez: From CS — top customer asks are: per-route tracing, longer retention for enterprise, and S3 export for compliance. Will pull exact customer notes. :point_down:
Kevin Park: Heads up from runtime: trace ingestion spikes cost. We should require sampling + adaptive defaults for Beta. Also need perf budget: dashboard query p95 target.
Sasha Iyer: Draft launch criteria proposal: (1) Dashboards: saved views, custom time ranges, shareable links; (2) Tracing: trace linking across requests, flamegraph, basic span search; (3) Error analysis: grouping, tag-based filters, RCA hints; (4) Retention: configurable buckets w/ defaults (7d for self-serve, 90d for enterprise) + export to S3 & KMS support.
Ben Ortiz: Add rollout plan: canary to 10% orgs, monitor latency & error regressions. Rollback if dashboard p95 latency increases >25% or ingestion error rate >1%.
Lara Chen: +1. Also need acceptance criteria: automated E2E tests for trace linking, dashboard render under load, and a tiny eval set to check error grouping quality. Suggest owners: Kevin -> perf & infra, Maria -> customer acceptance, Sasha -> product acceptance.
Kevin Park: Perf targets: dashboard render 95th <200ms for cached queries, <500ms uncached; perf harness should simulate 10k QPS of small queries and 5k trace events/sec. I'll carve out time with eng-sre.
Maria Gomez: I'll prioritize customers for Beta invites — three who requested retention/export. Will compile example data shapes.
Ben Ortiz: Proposal: GA must have billing & usage meters available (per-org usage dashboard), plus migration docs and support playbook. Without that, enterprise contracts will stall.
Lara Chen: Good catch. Also add legal/compliance checklist for retention/export (KMS, audit logs). We should tie those to OKR: "Enterprise readiness for observability" with owner and MRs.
Sasha Iyer: Quick scope negotiation: can we defer advanced anomaly detection and alerting rules to post-GA? Those are heavy ML pieces and risk delaying GA.
Kevin Park: Agree to defer; keep core telemetry + export + retention + basic alerts (thresholds) for GA. Advanced anomaly detection = Q after GA.
Maria Gomez: Customer ask: retention UI needs clear pricing impact. We should add a cost calc UI copy: "Estimated monthly cost for retention settings" so customers see tradeoffs.
Lara Chen: Action items I’ll take: create OKR PR with the gate checklist, assign owners, and draft Beta candidate list. Meeting: propose 10:30am Wed to finalize.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: feature/observability-staging -> staging at 2027-04-02T15:00:00Z (no downtime). :rocket:
Ben Ortiz: Thanks — will add perf tests to the staging job and a smoke-check that verifies trace linking.
Lara Chen: Great. If no objections I’ll file the PR and tag owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
